publisher: U.S. Treasury; University of Michigan CLOSUP; Kioko et al., Public Administration Review
vintage: Federal FY 2024–2025; local FY 2022–2024; state FY 2011–2021
table: Financial Report, Government Financial Position, Cash and Other Monetary Assets
title: Available opening treasury stock calibrations
universe: Federal operating cash; estimated available state and local reserves
geography: United States; local and state samples extrapolated explicitly to all 56 places
limits: Opening stock is not current-year revenue or a new appropriation. Fund balance is net resources, not a dated bank balance: state and local stock is an estimate. The state sample excludes 13 states and all territories. Local observations cover Michigan only, and general-government revenue is a proxy for general-fund revenue. Restricted/non-spendable assets are not added. A negative generated state net reserve contributes zero cash; opening legacy deficits are not supplied by this calibration.

federal.citation: Treasury FY 2025 Financial Report, Government Financial Position: operating cash was $871.9 billion in FY 2025 and $870.8 billion in FY 2024. https://fiscal.treasury.gov/accounting/us-financial-report/government-financial-position
federal.estimatedFrom: Mean of FY 2024 and FY 2025 operating cash, with a once-per-world offset within those observations. Other monetary assets are excluded.

spread.citation: FY 2024 and FY 2025 operating cash in the same Treasury Financial Report; a two-year range, not a population distribution.

state.citation: Kioko et al., Governing Reserves: Managerial Discretion and Government Creditworthiness, Public Administration Review (2026), Table 2: unassigned general fund balance as percent of total expenditures; 407 state-year observations, 37 states, FY 2011–2021. https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/puar.70220
state.estimatedFrom: Sample mean 1.3719% / 100, scaled by this government’s generated annual general-government spending. Same estimate for places outside the sample. Uses only unassigned net resources; excludes assigned, committed, restricted and non-spendable balances. Negative reserve estimates add zero cash; they do not create a positive reserve floor.

spread.citation: Table 2 sample interquartile range, -0.6863% to 3.8866%, divided by 100; not the entire observed range.

county.citation: University of Michigan CLOSUP, The Fiscal Health of Michigan Local Governments 2024 (March 2026), Table 2, unrestricted general fund balance/revenue medians, FY 2022–2024; Table 1, reporting units. https://closup.umich.edu/sites/closup/files/2026-03/CLOSUP-Fiscal-Health-Local-Gov-2024-Final.pdf
county.estimatedFrom: Mean of the three annual county medians, scaled by this government’s generated general-government revenue as a proxy for general-fund revenue. Michigan is the available county sample, not a measured average for each state. Fund balance is treated as available cash; exact fund assignments are not modeled.

spread.citation: County medians across FY 2022–2024; range of annual medians, not individual counties.

municipality.citation: University of Michigan CLOSUP, The Fiscal Health of Michigan Local Governments 2024 (March 2026), Table 2, unrestricted general fund balance/revenue medians, FY 2022–2024; Table 1, reporting units. https://closup.umich.edu/sites/closup/files/2026-03/CLOSUP-Fiscal-Health-Local-Gov-2024-Final.pdf
municipality.estimatedFrom: FY 2024 city and village medians weighted by their reporting-unit counts (274 and 241), not the pooled empirical median or mean. Applied to the government’s general-government revenue as a general-fund proxy. Outside Michigan this is a type proxy. Fund balance is treated as available cash; exact fund assignments are not modeled.

spread.citation: FY 2022–2024 city/village medians range from 0.380 to 0.815; not the range of individual municipalities.

township.citation: University of Michigan CLOSUP, The Fiscal Health of Michigan Local Governments 2024 (March 2026), Table 2, unrestricted general fund balance/revenue medians, FY 2022–2024; Table 1, reporting units. https://closup.umich.edu/sites/closup/files/2026-03/CLOSUP-Fiscal-Health-Local-Gov-2024-Final.pdf
township.estimatedFrom: Mean of FY 2022–2024 township medians, scaled by this government’s generated general-government revenue as a general-fund proxy. Outside Michigan this is a type proxy. Fund balance is treated as available cash; exact fund assignments are not modeled.

spread.citation: Township medians across FY 2022–2024; not the range of individual townships.
